mode: Window-free egui and lint checks only; no native-window, desktop, file-dialog or rendered-preview launches.
scope: Classic owns the skin chooser presentation. Wide layouts use three cards; narrow layouts stack cards in a bounded scroll area above fixed Continue/Apply and Cancel actions. Theme-aware original schematics show selected outlines and accessible radio states. First-visit Continue and changer Apply persist a staged choice; Cancel, window close and Escape dismiss it. Host preference writes stay first-pass-only. Text and Escape while choosing a skin preserve unpublished canvas text.
checks: New tests cover on-screen window/card/footer bounds, scroll reachability and stable footer placement at 1360x900 scale 1 light, 700x500 scale 2 dark, 360x360 scale 1 dark and 480x360 scale 2 light, with repeated layout passes. Cancel preserves raw preference bytes and document/history. Continue persists/restarts; changer Apply persists while preserving a pending canvas text draft. Escape preserves the draft and preference bytes. Existing first-visit, settings and frontend switching checks remain passing.
limits: Schematics are original layout illustrations, not rendered screenshots or native-reference reproductions. The chooser retains its existing modeless Window presentation. First-visit cancellation uses the default skin for the current run and prompts again at the next start until a choice is saved. Native/window-close appearance and full skin parity remain unverified; window-close dismissal is implemented but not independently exercised by the new tests.
